en.title: Lin-Manuel Miranda Writes 'Moana' Live-Action's New Song in Just One Week
en.summary: The mastermind behind the original "Moana" soundtrack returns with a brand-new track for the upcoming live-action adaptation. Discover the rapid creation and the star power behind "Along the Way."
en.body:
The magic of **Lin-Manuel Miranda**’s songwriting for Disney’s **Moana** is undeniable, and the Oscar nominee is back to add a fresh melody to the upcoming live-action remake. Miranda has penned a brand-new song, titled “Along the Way,” for the film, and the creative sprint to bring it to life was remarkably swift. He managed to write the entire piece in just one week, a testament to his prolific talent.

The new track, released on June 15, 2026, features the voices of **Catherine Laga'aia**, who steps into the titular role, alongside **Dwayne Johnson** as the mighty Maui, and a special appearance by original Moana voice actress **Auli'i Cravalho**. This collaboration brings together the past and the future of the beloved franchise, offering fans a nostalgic yet new auditory experience.

## A Song Born of Inspiration

Miranda, who has a long-standing relationship with Disney, having contributed to films like **Encanto** and **Mary Poppins Returns**, took on the challenge of adding to the already iconic **Moana** score. While the original film's songs are deeply cherished, the live-action version aims to offer something new for audiences. The creation of “Along the Way” in such a short timeframe underscores Miranda’s ability to capture the spirit and emotional core of a story and translate it into song with impressive speed. It’s a significant feat, especially considering the weight of expectation that comes with revisiting such a successful and beloved property.

## The Fan Connection

For fans of **Moana**, the addition of a new song by **Lin-Manuel Miranda** is a cause for celebration. The original soundtrack became a global phenomenon, with songs like “How Far I’ll Go” and “You’re Welcome” resonating deeply with audiences worldwide. The inclusion of “Along the Way” in the live-action film not only adds a fresh element to the narrative but also provides a direct link to the original creative genius. The fact that it features both the new Moana and the original voice actress alongside **Dwayne Johnson** suggests a thoughtful integration that honors the legacy of the first film while forging ahead. This new track is poised to become another fan favorite, weaving itself into the fabric of the **Moana** universe.

## What's Next

The live-action **Moana** is slated for release next month, with the new song already available for fans to enjoy. It will be fascinating to see how “Along the Way” is woven into the cinematic narrative and how it is received by audiences eager for more adventures on the high seas.
